# ILobby.SlotChanged event

Raised on the game's thread at the end of a frame when a slot got or lost its player or bot, whichever game plays it. Not raised as a lobby opens or closes.

```csharp
public event EventHandler<SlotChangedEventArgs>? SlotChanged;
```
